articles.text_snippet: Berkshire Hathaway's 400 million Coca-Cola shares, bought for $1,299 million between 1988 and 1994 and never added to since, now pay $848 million a year, about $2.3 million a day. Computed from Coca-Cola's split-adjusted dividend history, the checks since 1994 add up to about $13 billion, ten times the cost, and the next $212 million payment is due December 15.
articles.title: Warren Buffett Finished Buying Coca-Cola in August 1994 and Never Bought Another Share. Under Greg Abel, Berkshire Now Collects $2.3 Million a Day From It
